section_a_traditional_systems.description: Traditional lineage-based or systemic models of Sanskrit education.

courses_disciplines_taught: Vedangas (Shiksha, Vyakarana, Chhandas, Nirukta, Jyotisha, Kalpa)
systems.certification_model: Traditional titles (e.g., Vedaratna) transitioning to state-accredited boards
systems.pathway_into_modern_education: Prak-Shastri (+2 level) -> Shastri (BA level) university entry pipelines.
Fully recognized by UGC for civil services eligibility and modern academic lectureships.

section_b_non_formal_organizations.description: Voluntary, community, or non-profit systems promoting Sanskrit language acquisition.

organizations.certification: Samskrita Bharati Distance Education Certificates, 10-Day Spoken Sanskrit Camp Badges
organizations.audience_type: General Public, Families, Working Professionals, Youth
organizations.geographic_reach: Global (Pan-India chapters, USA, Australia, Europe, South America)
organizations.recognition_affiliation: Affiliated with several universities for credit transfers; widely recognized as the driving vehicle behind the Spoken Sanskrit Movement.
Institutional MoUs signed with various Central Universities in India for cooperative Sanskrit text studies.

platforms.fees: University Standard Tuition / Open Enrollment Options

platforms.certification: ANU Academic Transcript Credits / Languages Diploma
